name: id
description: Respondent identifier (1..N), one row per completed brand rating

name: brand
description: Brand the respondent rated: brand_a .. brand_e, cycling by row, an equal number of respondents each

name: quality
description: Rating 1-7: the brand makes high-quality products. Loads on the premium axis

name: premium
description: Rating 1-7: the brand feels premium. Loads on the premium axis

name: value
description: Rating 1-7: the brand is good value for money. Loads negatively on the premium axis (budget brands rate high)

name: modern
description: Rating 1-7: the brand feels modern. Loads on the modern axis

name: innovative
description: Rating 1-7: the brand brings out new ideas. Loads on the modern axis

name: heritage
description: Rating 1-7: the brand has a long tradition. Loads negatively on the modern axis (traditional brands rate high)
